releaseNotes: Fixes your library losing rows when the phone and the TV are used on the same account at the same time. Both devices used to read and then overwrite the same cloud record, so whichever saved second erased the other one, and Continue Watching entries could disappear. Saving is now atomic. Continue Watching also keeps the length of a show, so cards stop losing their progress bar and their time remaining, and the TV no longer uploads a fresh copy on every sync. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
